psychological_meaning: Torea Bay evokes feelings of trust, stability, and intelligence. As a deep, muted blue, it suggests reliability and a sense of calm authority. It can also represent depth, introspection, and a connection to the vastness of the ocean or sky, providing a sense of peace and security.
